title: Member candidates tabletop sign
slide_intent: Make an administrative message easy to find while preserving institutional ownership.
strategic_value: A restrained title and small monogram can turn an ordinary event sign into a coherent touchpoint.
demonstration: A black tabletop sign reads Member Candidates in white at upper left and carries a small lab mark at lower left.
practical_value: Study separation of message and endorsement across a simple surface.
